The plugin marketplace manifest listing the document-skills and example-skills sets by skill path.
The install-starter script: links five starter skills into the agent and Claude skill folders, refusing to overwrite anything already there.
This map: what each top-level path in the folder is for and who owns it.
The skills themselves, one folder each with a SKILL.md: document skills, design and creative ones, developer tools, plus Hines additions such as checkpoint, ponytail and academy-guide.
A pointer to the Agent Skills specification at its public home.
A blank skill template with the required front matter.
Attribution notices for third-party software included in the skills.
Holds tools/workspace, the data files the central house checkers read for this folder.

Data files the central house checkers read for this folder: the contract, the list of top-level items, the ignore probes and the outside readers. The checker programs themselves live in hinescreative/house-migration.
